# osureplayer

**Offline, local testing only. Uploading or submitting scores generated by replay playback is strictly prohibited. Stay offline while using this tool.**

## Usage

1. Open osu!stable in standard mode while offline.
2. Run `osureplayer.exe`.
3. Drag an `.osr` replay into the console and press **Enter**.
4. Wait for `Ready`, then start or retry the matching beatmap in osu!.
5. Keep the game focused. Cursor and button playback starts automatically when the song synchronizes.

Match the game's Mods to the replay for accurate playback. A Mods mismatch displays a warning but does not stop playback.

Press **F8**, **Escape**, or **Ctrl+C** to stop playback. At the replay prompt, enter `q` or `exit` to close the program.

## Command line

```text
osureplayer.exe
osureplayer.exe --interactive [options]
osureplayer.exe play "C:\path\replay.osr" [options]
osureplayer.exe --help
```

| Option | Usage |
| --- | --- |
| `--keys ZX` | Set K1 and K2 bindings; defaults to `Z` and `X`. |
| `--smoke-key C` | Set the smoke binding; defaults to `C`. |
| `--rect <left> <top> <width> <height>` | Override the playfield rectangle in game client pixels. |

Key bindings must be distinct letters (`A`–`Z`) or digits (`0`–`9`) and match your game settings.

```text
osureplayer.exe --interactive --keys DF --smoke-key C
osureplayer.exe play "C:\path\replay.osr" --keys DF
```
